## Executive Summary
Cyber Security Technical Lead and security researcher specializing in Industrial Control Systems (ICS/OT) and Offensive & Defensive AI Security. Extensive track record leading threat modeling for complex products in the design phase, performing penetration testing across embedded systems, firmware, cloud, mobile, and APIs, and driving security certifications (ISO 27001:2013 and IEC 62443-4-1:2018). Passionate about adversarial AI red teaming, prompt injection and jailbreak defense engineering, open-source security tool development, and publishing responsible vulnerability disclosures.

## Disclosed CVEs & Security Advisories

### CVE-2022-22987: Advantech ADAM-3600
- **Severity:** Critical (CVSS v3.1: 9.8)
- **Target Component:** Advantech ADAM-3600 (firmware up to v2.6.2)
- **Vulnerability Detail:** Hardcoded private key in the project directory allowed unauthenticated remote attackers to gain administrative web server access.
- **Official Advisory:** CISA Advisory ICSA-22-032-02 (https://www.cisa.gov/uscert/ics/advisories/icsa-22-032-02)

### CVE-2023-24181: OpenWrt LuCI Reflected XSS
- **Severity:** Medium (CWE-79)
- **Target Component:** OpenWrt LuCI (branch openwrt-22.03) via `/openvpn/pageswitch.htm`
- **Vulnerability Detail:** Reflected Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) allowing execution of arbitrary JavaScript in the context of an authenticated administrator session.
- **Official Advisory:** NVD CVE-2023-24181 (https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2023-24181)

### CVE-2023-24182: OpenWrt LuCI Stored XSS
- **Severity:** Medium (CWE-79)
- **Target Component:** OpenWrt LuCI (branch openwrt-22.03) via `/system/sshkeys.js`
- **Vulnerability Detail:** Stored Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) enabling persistent payload execution within the web management console.
- **Official Advisory:** NVD CVE-2023-24182 (https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2023-24182)

## Featured Open Source Projects

### TimeHammer
- **URL:** https://github.com/neutrinoguy/timehammer
- **Language:** Go
- **Summary:** Cross-platform Network Time Protocol (NTP) security and resilience testing tool built specifically for IoT and embedded devices. Features an interactive terminal UI (TUI) to simulate clock drift, time spoofing, Kiss-of-Death packets, client fuzzing, and Y2K38 rollovers.

### VoidProbe
- **URL:** https://github.com/neutrinoguy/VoidProbe
- **Language:** Go
- **Summary:** Real-time monitoring and security assessment tool for Linux-based embedded systems. Assesses devices against IEC 62443-4-2 Denial of Service (DoS) Resistance and Resilience to Resource Management (DRRM) requirements via lightweight SSH telemetry agents.

### Devicestats (Drozer Module)
- **URL:** https://github.com/neutrinoguy/devicestats
- **Language:** Python
- **Summary:** Custom module for the Drozer mobile security assessment framework to extract hardware, operating system, and security configuration telemetry from target Android devices.

### Awesome-ICS-Writeups
- **URL:** https://github.com/neutrinoguy/awesome-ics-writeups
- **Summary:** Curated collection of industrial cybersecurity resources, SCADA exploit writeups, architecture guides, and threat assessments.

### Cloud Honeypot & Analytics Pipeline
- **Stack:** GCP, Cowrie, adbhoney, Elasticsearch, Logstash, Kibana (ELK)
- **Summary:** Deployed automated distributed honeypots on Google Cloud Platform to collect, analyze, and visualize real-time attacker behavioral telemetry.
